subtitulo: Pick a chronicle or start a new one.

vacio.descripcion: Create a campaign or load the examples with “make seed”.

crear.descripcion: Choose the name and the game-system modules it will use.
crear.sinModulos: No modules installed: the campaign will use only the generic core.
crear.nucleo: The generic core (characters, places, factions…) is always included.

borrar.aviso: All its data, proposals and history will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

importar.descripcion: Upload a ZIP exported from LoreGraph. You can give it another identifier or name so it does not clash with an existing campaign.
importar.idAyuda: Leave it empty to use the one in the file.
importar.conflicto: A campaign with that identifier already exists. Type another one in “New identifier”.
